read.en: Micron fell 1.1% on Nov 10 to $725.11, trading $699.63–745.64. It is above the 5-day ($720.0) and below the 10-day ($809.1), 30-day ($917.9), 100-day ($952.2) and 200-day ($760.1); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 30, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($920.41), and RSI is 36.
read.zh: 美光 11月10日下跌 1.1%，收于 $725.11，盘中区间 $699.63–745.64。股价位于 5 日（$720.0）均线上方，10 日（$809.1）、30 日（$917.9）、100 日（$952.2）和 200 日（$760.1）均线下方；仅 200 日均线在上行。MACD 自 10月30日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$920.41），RSI 为 36。

read.en: No level changed: the $745.64 high again stalled at the $737.9–746 zone, and the close held the $724.8 Nov 6 high, with the 5-day ($720) just below. Resistance is $737.9–745.6 (Jul 29 low, Nov 9–10 highs), then $760.1–761.8 (200-day, Nov 5 high) and $782–795. Support is $720–724.8, then $689.7–699.6 (Nov 9 and Nov 10 lows) and $650–676. A close above $745.6 would target $760–762; below $720, $690–700.
